info.title: Mapilio API
info.summary: Versioned contracts implemented by the modern Mapilio backend.
info.description: This document grows endpoint by endpoint as modern contracts are implemented and tested. It is separate from the legacy compatibility inventory.

servers.description: Production API; modern route activation remains subject to release gates.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: First-party authentication contracts for Mapilio clients.

post.description: Creates an inactive account and sends a time-limited signed activation link. Callback hosts and schemes are server allowlisted.

message: Check your email to activate your account.

400.description: The identity, callback, or request fields were rejected.

429.description: The registration rate limit was exceeded.

503.description: Account creation or activation email delivery is unavailable.

post.description: Returns the same success response for known and unknown addresses. A known active account receives a time-limited signed reset link.

200.description: The request was accepted without confirming account existence.

400.description: The request fields or callback were rejected.

429.description: The per-address or per-IP reset rate limit was exceeded.

post.description: Consumes the short-lived opaque code produced after the signed email link is opened. A code can be used only once.

200.description: Password changed and reset code consumed.

400.description: The reset code is invalid, expired, consumed, or the passwords do not match.

429.description: The password renewal rate limit was exceeded.

get.description: Returns the authenticated mobile profile in the legacy-compatible data wrapper. The data value is null when the profile record is unavailable; otherwise it is an array containing the profile.

200.description: The authenticated profile, or a null data value when no profile record is available.

401.description: A valid mobile bearer token is required.

post.description: Updates bounded profile fields and optionally stores a validated profile image on the configured persistent disk.

400.description: Profile fields, username, or image were rejected.

401.description: A valid mobile bearer token is required.

429.description: The authenticated account-write rate limit was exceeded.

post.description: Sends a signed confirmation to the new unique address. The stored address changes only after confirmation and this flow is unavailable to ordinary password accounts.

400.description: The email is invalid or already used.

401.description: A valid mobile bearer token is required.

409.description: The current account is not eligible for placeholder-email replacement.

429.description: The authenticated account-write rate limit was exceeded.

delete.summary: Delete and anonymize the authenticated mobile account
delete.description: Preserves contribution ownership while removing personal profile fields and disabling the identity so all current access and refresh tokens stop working. Apple authorization is revoked before deletion; provider failure leaves the account unchanged.

200.description: The identity was anonymized and disabled.

400.description: Deletion confirmation or login type was rejected.

401.description: A valid mobile bearer token is required.

429.description: The account-deletion rate limit was exceeded.

503.description: Apple authorization could not be revoked; no account data was changed.

post.summary: Exchange a provider token for Mapilio mobile tokens
post.description: The backend validates the provider token through the configured legacy migration bridge. Legacy client credentials are server-side configuration and are never accepted from the mobile request; only modern Mapilio access and refresh tokens are returned.

401.description: Provider token is invalid or the mapped legacy account is inactive

example.message: Too many authentication attempts. Please try again later.

get.description: Preserves the legacy sequence-detail wrapper and capture-time ordering when neither page nor per_page is supplied. Supplying either parameter opts into the bounded pagination contract; page defaults to 1 and per_page defaults to 500, with per_page capped at 1000.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional strict positive canonical integer. Supplying page activates pagination; defaults to 1 when omitted.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Optional strict positive canonical integer, maximum 1000. Supplying per_page activates pagination; defaults to 500 when omitted.

200.description: Legacy full-read response when pagination is not requested, or bounded paginated response when page or per_page is supplied.

400.description: The required sequence_uuid parameter is missing.

413.description: The legacy/default-v1 full read exceeded the configured row or encoded-item bound.

422.description: An explicitly supplied pagination parameter was not a canonical positive integer or exceeded the per_page maximum.

message: 'page' and 'per_page' must be positive integers within the supported range.

get.description: Preserves the legacy embed wrapper and id ordering when neither page nor per_page is supplied. Supplying either parameter opts into bounded pagination; info remains present on every paginated response and entries contains only the requested page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional strict positive canonical integer. Supplying page activates pagination; defaults to 1 when omitted.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Optional strict positive canonical integer, maximum 1000. Supplying per_page activates pagination; defaults to 500 when omitted.

200.description: Legacy full-read response when pagination is not requested, or bounded paginated response when page or per_page is supplied.

413.description: The legacy/default-v1 full read exceeded the configured row or encoded-item bound.

422.description: An explicitly supplied pagination parameter was not a canonical positive integer or exceeded the per_page maximum.

message: 'page' and 'per_page' must be positive integers within the supported range.

get.summary: Get a canonical AI feature and its matched imagery observations

404.description: Feature not found or invalid path id.

503.description: Canonical graph is unavailable or fails integrity checks.

post.description: Proxies a public subscription request to the configured newsletter provider without exposing provider credentials.

202.description: The subscription request was accepted, including an idempotent duplicate or honeypot request.

422.description: The email or honeypot field failed request validation.

429.description: The per-IP rate limit was exceeded.

503.description: The newsletter provider is unavailable or not safely configured.

post.summary: Issue or refresh a first-party web bearer token
post.description: A public browser client does not send a confidential OAuth client secret. Password and refresh grants retain the transitional bearer-token contract used by existing Mapilio APIs.

200.description: A new bearer and refresh token pair.

400.description: Credentials, account state, grant, or refresh token were rejected.

422.description: The request fields failed validation or size limits.

429.description: The per-IP authentication rate limit was exceeded.

503.description: Token signing or the identity store is unavailable.

website.description: Honeypot field. Human clients leave this empty.

items.const: 'page' and 'per_page' must be positive integers within the supported range.
